rules.name: Total Air Superiority
rules.description:
Fighter Interdiction: Your opponent must roll a 5+ for their aircraft to arrive (instead of the usual 4+).

Perfect Timing: Discard this card before rolling. When Rolling for Aircraft arrival, your Aircraft arrive on a 3+ (instead of the usual 4+) this turn.

rules.name: Lucky
rules.description: Discard this card to re-roll any one die. The second result must be used.

rules.name: French Resistance Raid
rules.description: Discard this card after your opponent rolls for Reserves. Your opponent must re-roll their Reserve rolls.

rules.name: Naval Gunfire
rules.description:
Each Shooting Step, choose a Formation HQ Team or an Observer to request a Naval Gunfire bombardment. On a roll of 5+ they may Spot for a four-gun Naval Gunfire Bombardment using their own Skill rating and the following weapon stats:

Range		|	ROF			|	Anti-Tank	|	Firepower
Unlimited	|	Artillery		|	4			|	Auto

Remove the Ranged In marker for this bombardment at the end of the Shooting Step.

sharedRules.name: Bunker Killer
sharedRules.description: Bunker Killer teams can hit Nest and Bunder Teams despite being an Artillery Bombardment. As a Brutal weapon, any Infantry, Gun (including Nests and Bunkers), or Unarmoured Tank Teams it hits must re-roll successful Saves.

sharedRules.name: Petard
sharedRules.description:
When firing a Bombardment with their Petard, AVRE teams:
May spot and fire Bombardments even if they moved this turn.
Do not need to re-roll successful rolls To Hit for only having 1 or 2 weapons firing, and
Ignore the Danger Close rule.

sharedRules.name: Flame Trailers
sharedRules.description: Flame tanks cannot Charge into Contact and cannot Hold Objectives.

sharedRules.name: Flame-thrower
sharedRules.description:
Infantry, Gun and Unarmoured Tank Teams re-roll successful Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower and the Unit is automatically Pinned Down. Armoured Tank Teams use their Top armour for Armour Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower.

Flame-throwers my shoot in Defensive Fire. Howeverm while a Unit that is Hit by a Flame-thrower is Pinned Down, this does not automatically stop the assault, The defender still needs to score five (or eight) hits to sop the assault as normal.

sharedRules.name: Airborne
sharedRules.description: This Formation may make an Airborne Assault in missions that use the Airborden Assault rules (page 84)

sharedRules.name: Mike Target
sharedRules.description: When a Spotting Team successfully Rages In an Artillery Unit with Mike Target, they may immediatly roll to Range In another Artillery Unit. If successful, the additional Artillery Unit is treated as Ranging In on the same attempt as the first.

sharedRules.name: Night Attack
sharedRules.description:
If a Force with Night Attack is the attacker in a mission where the defender has Minefields, the player may attack at night. If they do so, Night Fighting rules (see page 113 of the rulebook) are in effect at the start of the game.

British Units from a Formation with  Night Attack can move freely from the start of the game. Friendly Units from other Formations or Support may not more out of their Deployment Area untill morning breaks.

sharedRules.name: Air Observer Post
sharedRules.description:
An Air Observer Post is an Aircraft that arrives on a roll of 3+ (rather than the usual 4+)

An Air Observer Post is unarmed, but can act as an Observer Spotting for an Artillery Bombardment with an Aiming Pont within 12"/30cm of tha Aircraft. The opposing player may shoot at the Aircraft immediately before it rolls to Range In as though the aircraft was Shooting.

sharedRules.name: Unit Transport
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of the Transport Attachment must end the Movement Step within 6"/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on the table. If it cannot do this, then the Transport Attachment must be Sent to the Rear (see page 45 of the rulebook)

sharedRules.name: Mind and Heart
sharedRules.description: Teams from the Commando Troop HQ and Commando Sections in this Formation that start their Movement Step adjecent to a cliff (or similar Impassable terrain feature) roll a Skill Test. If successful, the team may cross the terrain at Terrain Dash speed.

sharedRules.name: Already Here
sharedRules.description: This Platoon counts as being 0 points when calculating reserves.

sharedRules.name: Pioneers
sharedRules.description: Infantry teams in this Formation's Rifle Platoons cross Minefields safely on a roll of 3+ and Dig In on a roll of 3+.

sharedRules.name: Passengers 5
sharedRules.description: Team can carry five Infantry Team as Passangers

rules.name: Unflappable
rules.description:
Tanks and Infantry Units in this Formation have Unflappable rating

Last Stand 3+

rules.name: Relentless
rules.description:
Units in this Formation gain the Determination rating.

Remount 3+

rules.name: Cautious Not Stupid
rules.description: During the Starting Step, when Rallying Pinned Down Units, you may discard this card to automatically Rally a Pinned Down Unit from this Formation.

rules.name: Peter Young
rules.description: This Unit and other Commando Units from this Formation that have their Unit Leader within 6"/15cm of the Formation Commander, and that are in Concealing Terrain, are Gone to Ground unless they Shoot or Assault.

rules.name: Richard Pine-Coffin
rules.description:
This Formation Commander and any Unit attached to it pass their Counterattack rolls on a 2+.

This Formation Commander hits on a 2+ in Assaults.

rules.name: Stan Hollis
rules.description:
This Unit Leader hits on a 2+ in Assaults. This Unit replaces the War Weary rating with the following rating.

Stan Hollis
Rally 2+

Any Unit from this Formation that has their Unit Leader within 6"/15cm of this Unit Leader will Rally on a 3+.

Stan Hollis
Rally 3+

rules.name: Joe Ekins
rules.description:
The Firefly (17 pdr) tank in this platoon may re-roll any of its failed To Hit rolls.

The Firefly (17 pdr) weapon in this Unit gains the Precise rule.

Precise: Target Armour is not increased for range over 16"/40cm.

rules.name: Davide V. Currie
rules.description:
This Commander's Leadership range is increased to 8"/20cm instead of its normal 6"/15cm.

This Formation Commander may roll two dice instead of one To Hit during Assaults.

rules.name: Sydney Valepy Radley-Walters
rules.description:
This Unit passes Blitz Move Orders on a 3+.

Tank Teams hit by this Formation Commander's tank must re-roll their successful armour saves.

rules.name: Gammon Bombs
rules.description: Discard this card to give Infantry teams in this Unit Anti-tank 3 and Firepower AUTO against Top Armour in Assaults untile the end of the turn.

rules.name: .50 cal Carrier
rules.description: Universal Carriers in this Universal Carrier Patrol loose their normal Universal Carrier (MGs) weapon and gains the .50 cal MG weapon with the Self-defence AA rule.

rules.name: Bagpipes
rules.description:
Units in this Formation may re-roll a faileed attempt to Rally from Pinned Down as long as their Unit Leader is within 4"/10cm of a Churchill (75mm), Churchill 6pdr), or Churchill (Late 75mm) Tank team that is not Bailed Out.

You may also take the 6th Guards Tank Brigade Title card in your force.

rules.name: AVRE Assault Bridge
rules.description:
While this card is face up the Unit Leader cannot Shoot or Assault.

You may deploy this card at the end of any movement steo, placing it face down completely within 4"/10cm of the Unit Leader. This card becomes a bridge that can be used to cross a seawall, creek, stream, or river covered by this card at Tactical or Terrain Dash speed.

rules.name: Sherman DD
rules.description: All Sherman tanks in this Unit gain Amphibious. The tank's MGs have a Moving and Halted ROF of 3. A Sherman cannot Shoot or Charge into Contact and Assault while it is in Impassable Water terrain.

rules.name: Sherman Mineflails
rules.description: All Tank teams in this Unit have Mine Clearing Devices and may be given the Mine Clearing order (page 112 of the rulebook).

rules.name: Carrier Transport
rules.description:
This Infantry or Gun Unit may add a Carrier Transport Attachment. The number of vehicles in the Unit is as follows:
-Add one Carrier Transport for every Infantry or Gun Team in the Unit.

These transports are unarmed.

rules.name: M5 Half-track Transport
rules.description:
This Infantry or Gun Unit may add an M5 Half-track Transport Attachment. The number of vehicles in the Unit is as follows:
-Add one M5 Half-track Transport for each Bren Gun team or two Sten SMG in the Unit.
-Add one M5 Half-track Transport for each Gun team in the Unit.

These transports are unarmed.

rules.name: Kangaroo  Transport
rules.description:
This Infantry Unit may add a Kangaroo Transport Attachment. The number of vehicles in the Unit is as follows:
-Add one M5 Half-track Transport for every three Infantry Teams in the Unit.

rules.name: 3-Ton Lorry Transport
rules.description:
This Infantry or Gun Unit may add a 3-Ton Lorry Transport Transport Attachment. The number of vehicles in the Unit is as follows:
-Add one 3-Ton Lorry Transport for every five Infantry Teams in the Unit.
-Add one 3-Ton Lorry Transport for each Gun team in the Unit.

These transports are unarmed and unarmoured.

rules.name: AGRA
rules.description: When your Force is the Attacker, all 25pdr Field Troops have a Firepower rating of 3+ (instead of the usual 4+) whent they Repeat a Bombardment for +1 point per gun.
